subject: Invoice release constraints & PO field mapping — Aegis Health procurement
messages:
From: Claire Dunne <claire.dunne@aegishealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: tim.lowe@aegishealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood — billing/PO field and invoice release constraints

Hi Priya,

Quick note from procurement as we're finalizing the SOW: Aegis requires the following on every invoice for payment to process through our ERP: PO number (exact match to PO header), BU cost center code (6 digits), project code, and tax entity ID. In our environment we have two active legal entities that will be billed separately, so invoices must be split per entity and delivered as separate monthly invoices.

We also need the invoices to be released on a deterministic cadence: end-of-month batch with invoice date = last business day. Net terms are standard net45 for our vendors, but we have one accounting caveat — we cannot accept consolidated invoices that mix entities unless each invoice has the entity_id header and a mapping table.

Attached is a sample PO and our procurement questionnaire (Aegis_PO_Sample.pdf; Aegis_procurement_questionnaire.xlsx). Please confirm if Redwood can:
- Emit per-entity invoices automatically from the billing system
- Provide PO field mapping (exact header names) to ensure matching in our ERP
- Support net45 and monthly release cadence, and whether that affects eligibility for the volume discount we discussed

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Best,
Claire
Claire Dunne
Senior Procurement Manager
Aegis Health

From: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dunne <claire.dunne@aegishealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood — billing/PO field and invoice release constraints

Claire — thanks for the clear checklist and the attachments. We can support per-entity invoices and include the PO number and a custom header for entity_id, cost center, and project code. A few clarifying items so we scope the billing work accurately:

1) Invoice splitting: are the two legal entities mapped to separate vendor IDs in your ERP (i.e., do you expect two distinct vendor numbers on each invoice)?
2) Header names: we can emit headers but need to confirm exact field names your AP system expects (we can map aliases).
3) Discount behavior: our commercial team typically ties tiered discounts to consolidated monthly usage across the account. If invoices are split by legal entity, we need to understand whether Aegis will apply credits/discounts centrally or per-entity. That impacts how we present pricing on the invoices.
4) Net terms: net45 is fine from a policy perspective, but it will affect the finance approval for the 8% early-payment volume discount Vanessa proposed — that discount assumes net30.

I'll loop in Vanessa and Vivek (cc'd) to propose a couple of commercial options. If convenient, can we do a 30-minute call tomorrow?

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dunne <claire.dunne@aegishealth.com>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood — billing/PO field and invoice release constraints

Claire — appreciate the details. Short version from commercial: we can accommodate the invoice-field mapping and per-entity invoices; to keep pricing and discounts aligned, here are two practical paths:

Option A — Centralized discount (preferred): Redwood issues separate invoices per legal entity as required, but we provide a monthly consolidated usage statement and credit schedule so Aegis can reconcile a single discount across the account. Requires a signed mutual action on how credits are applied (we provide a credit memo to the billed entity). Net terms remain net45.

Option B — Entity-level pricing: Each entity is billed and discounted independently. To preserve the 8% volume discount, each billed entity needs to meet the usage thresholds. In this case we would require net30 for early-payment discounts; standard net45 would default to the standard tiered list pricing.

Operational asks: for Option A we need your AP to accept credit memos and the mapping table for entity-to-vendor_id. For Option B we need each entity's PO and vendor number up front.

If you prefer, we can do a hybrid where the master services agreement includes consolidated discounting language and SOWs list the entity billing details. Happy to discuss on the call.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Tim Lowe <tim.lowe@aegishealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Dunne <claire.dunne@aegishealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood — billing/PO field and invoice release constraints

Thanks Vanessa/Priya — quick clarifications from AP side:
- Aegis can accept credit memos but they need to reference the invoice number being credited and the vendor_id for traceability.
- We prefer Option A (centralized discount) because downstream finance wants a consolidated view for chargebacks between entities. If Redwood can emit a consolidated usage report plus per-entity invoices and provide credits as you suggested, that will work.
- Our ERP requires the header name "entity_id" exactly and the cost center must be labeled "cost_center_code". Project code header should be "proj_code".
- We will provide the vendor IDs and a sample mapping tomorrow morning.

We've penciled a 30-minute call for Wed 09:00 PT to align the implementation details.

Tim
Timothy Lowe
AP Manager, Aegis Health

From: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Lowe <tim.lowe@aegishealth.com>, Claire Dunne <claire.dunne@aegishealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2027 14:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood — billing/PO field and invoice release constraints

Thanks Tim — this is very helpful and actionable. Next steps agreed:
1) Aegis to share vendor_id mapping and sample PO field names (Tim/Claire).
2) Redwood engineering will schedule a small billing-systems change to emit per-entity invoices and include header names exactly as "entity_id", "cost_center_code", and "proj_code"; expected ETA for a test invoice: 10 business days post-mapping receipt.
3) Commercial: we'll proceed with Option A (centralized discount with credit memos). Vanessa will draft the credit memo workflow and a short annex to the SOW describing reconciliation and credit issuance.
4) Priya & Markus will validate that credit memo flow does not break revenue recognition rules; if it does, we will propose an alternative settlement cadence.

I've added the SOW draft (Redwood_SOW_v1.docx) to the thread for context. See you on the call tomorrow 09:00 PT.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
